high_level_description: Wordless Gothic stained-glass narrative inspired by the medieval windows of Chartres: one glassworker marks a cobalt archive coffer in the upper medallion, while two equal lower repositories preserve identical copies with the same notched amber seal, making duplicated availability visible without transferring authorship to either custodian.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A tall lancet opening is divided by pale limestone tracery into one modest upper roundel and two strictly equal lower bays. Deep cobalt, ruby, emerald, and amber glass fills the surrounding geometric fields under neutral daylight. The lower bays share identical width, height, illumination, stone bases, and borders; neither occupies the center. No cross, halo, throne, crown, inscription, letter, numeral, arrow, host mark, ranking emblem, or ceremonial pedestal appears anywhere.

elements.desc: Glassworker who originated the archive, shown kneeling in the small upper roundel, medium-brown skin, short black curls, plain ivory tunic, cobalt mantle, attentive downward gaze. Both hands press a simple brass die into the front of a closed cobalt coffer, leaving one amber circular seal with a triangular notch at its lower-right edge.

Left glazed archive cabinet in the lower-left bay, with a pale stone frame and two clear doors, exactly equal to the right cabinet. Inside rests one closed cobalt coffer identical to the upper original; its sole amber disk seal retains the same size, position, and lower-right triangular notch. No die, brush, or paint is present.

Right glazed archive cabinet in the lower-right bay, with a pale stone frame and two clear doors, exactly equal to the left cabinet. Inside rests one closed cobalt coffer identical to the upper original; its sole amber disk seal retains the same size, position, and lower-right triangular notch. No die, brush, or paint is present.

Left custodian standing beside the lower-left cabinet, medium skin tone, straight dark hair tied low, plain emerald ankle-length dress, cobalt belt, calm gaze toward the stored coffer. Her open empty hands remain away from both cabinet and seal; she carries no die, brush, palette, badge, crown, or signing tool.

Right custodian standing beside the lower-right cabinet at exactly the same scale, dark skin tone, cropped black hair, plain amber tunic, deep-blue trousers, calm gaze toward the stored coffer. His open empty hands remain away from both cabinet and seal; he carries no die, brush, palette, badge, crown, or signing tool.
